description: Check npm or PyPI purl lists or raw lockfiles: upgrades judged on advisories, KEV, licence; same version, other hash = hash_mismatch. Returns go, review, no_go.

from.description: Packages before, as purls with a version, e.g. pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.15 or pkg:pypi/requests@2.31.0 (npm and PyPI only); or {purl, integrity} with an SRI hash (sha512-...) from the lockfile

integrity.description: SRI hash, e.g. sha512-<base64>; several space-separated hashes allowed; null = none

from_lockfile.description: Instead of from: the text of a package-lock.json, yarn.lock, requirements.txt or poetry.lock (1 MB at most; the whole body 2.5 MB). Lists every package version it pins, with its integrity hash when it has one. Each side is capped at 5,000 distinct packages (413 too_many_items). Send from or from_lockfile, not both

to.description: Packages after, as purls with a version (or {purl, integrity}); a package in both lists at another version is judged, one in a single list is reported added or removed; the same version with two different integrity hashes is a hash_mismatch finding (decision review)

integrity.description: SRI hash, e.g. sha512-<base64>; several space-separated hashes allowed; null = none

to_lockfile.description: Instead of to: the text of a package-lock.json, yarn.lock, requirements.txt or poetry.lock (1 MB at most). Each side is capped at 5,000 distinct packages (413 too_many_items). Send to or to_lockfile, not both

name: stackfacts_lockfile_diff
